SignupConfirmation.approvedBody: Your email is confirmed and your access has been granted.
SignupConfirmation.pendingBody: Your request went to the OCA team. You will get an email once they review it.
SignupConfirmation.rejectedBody: This access request was not approved.
SignupConfirmation.failedTitle: We could not confirm your email
SignupConfirmation.failedBody: The link may have expired, already been used, or been replaced by a newer email — only the link in the latest email works. If you have already confirmed your email, just sign in. If not, enter your email to get a new link.
SignupConfirmation.resent: If the address is registered, a new email was sent. Use its link: the one in the previous email no longer works.
SignupConfirmation.resendTooSoon: We sent an email a moment ago. Please wait before asking for another.
